# How to Find Sponsorship Opportunities

URL: https://howtofindsponsorshipopportunities.com
Description: A free guide to finding, pricing and pitching sponsorships, written by Ryan Doyle, founder of Sponsor Radar (sponsorradar.co). Newsletter prices come from 321 newsletters' rate cards (read 29 September 2026); pitch and reply figures from Sponsor Radar's 13,429 pitches to brands (27 August to 24 September 2026).

## Quick Answer

Find sponsors by listing brands that already sponsor creators like you, pricing from real rate cards and pitching each brand with a short email and one follow-up. Brands with a newsletter ad on record replied to Sponsor Radar's pitches at 2.6%, twice the 1.3% of brands with none (13,429 pitches, 27 August to 24 September 2026). Newsletters list one issue's main sponsor slot at a median $310 at 5,000 to 19,999 subscribers (321 newsletters, 29 September 2026).
